review.imagery: Root reviewed all twenty-eight unique original PDF pages, seven whole drawing and map choices, every visible enlarged type schedule, thirteen native resources and both own website contacts. Eleven distinct native project concepts and two corroborated own-page concepts are retained. Generic people, stock amenities, decorative textures and duplicate night crops are excluded. The original 3 BR villa B table is outside the physical page edge, so hidden extracted figures are excluded. All source levels and middle/corner variants remain intact. The 530-home Village 1 parcel is distinguished from the broader 838-home factsheet. The current own marker explicitly names Taormina Village.
review.floorPlans: All selected whole original sheets, complete numerical schedules, source notices and every drawn level visually reviewed by root. Measurement and source-edition conflicts remain explicit.
review.location: Whole original map and factsheets reviewed. Travel modes retain source scope. Unreliable phase markers are excluded. Missing coordinates use project-name directions.
review.provenance: Fresh ordinary GET receipts preserve URLs, dates, bytes and SHA256. Visible original panels determine adopted measurements. Hidden off-page figures are excluded. The complete source pages and notices remain unedited. Independent values, resources and delivered pixels must pass before verified status.

unavailable: A visually verifiable 3 BR villa B total, identified construction photographs, exact home entrances and selected contractual phase remain unverified.
